steps.code:
# Download and extract the Android arm64 C++ SDK:
# https://github.com/zetic-ai/melange-cpp-python/releases/download/v0.1.6/zetic-mlange-cpp-0.1.6-android-arm64.zip
# Set ZeticMlange_DIR to <SDK>/lib/cmake/ZeticMlange.
# Build with the Android NDK toolchain, -DANDROID_ABI=arm64-v8a
# and -DANDROID_STL=c++_shared.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(my_app LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(ZeticMlange CONFIG REQUIRED)
add_executable(my_app main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(my_app PRIVATE zetic::mlange)
